title: Pocket Full of Clouds
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found a peach in my coat
By the bus stop bench
Sticky on my thumb
Like a small sweet dare

You said, take the long way
So I missed the train
Now I'm grinning at rain
Like it owes me change

[Pre-Chorus]
And the day got loose
In my open hands
One small bite
Turned the whole thing gold

[Chorus]
Pocket full of clouds
Pocket full of clouds
I keep one for later
And one for now

Pocket full of clouds
Pocket full of clouds
If the world turns heavy
I float it out (float it out)

[Verse 2]
There's a blue cup dented
On the curb by school
Little paper boat
In a drainage pool

I chase a red kite
Through a parking lot
Laughing at the dog
That almost got my spot

[Pre-Chorus]
And the day got loose
In my open hands
One small bite
Turned the whole thing gold

[Chorus]
Pocket full of clouds
Pocket full of clouds
I keep one for later
And one for now

Pocket full of clouds
Pocket full of clouds
If the world turns heavy
I float it out (float it out)

[Bridge]
Maybe that's enough
Just a cracked-up sky
Maybe joy is found
In the left-behind

[Chorus]
Pocket full of clouds
Pocket full of clouds
I keep one for later
And one for now

Pocket full of clouds
Pocket full of clouds
If the world turns heavy
I float it out (float it out)
